nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117‑3.3 LDO converts VIN_5V to VCC_3V3. Provides a clean 3.3 V rail for digital logic (ATmega328P, MCP4725). Bypass capacitors are required at VIN and VOUT pins. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P MCU running at 3.3 V. Controls the DAC via a shared I2C bus (SCL output, SDA bidirectional). VCC_3V3 powers core and AVCC. All digital I/Os referenced to GND.

nodes.name: dac
nodes.description: MCP4725 12‑bit I2C DAC powered from VCC_3V3. Provides VOUT as a programmable bias voltage for the NE5532 non‑inverting input. SDA is bidirectional, SCL is input‑only on the slave side. VSS tied to GND.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: amp
nodes.description: NE5532 dual op‑amp used as a single‑ended non‑inverting pre‑amplifier on channel 1. Positive supply (VCC_P) is VIN_5V, negative supply (VCC_N) is GND. IN1_P receives the DAC bias voltage, IN1_N is tied to a safe bias (ground). OUT1 delivers the amplified audio signal. Channel 2 inputs are tied to a quiet bias and its output is left unused.
